description: DELETE, without force, elements whose only consumer is what the platform generates together with them (tested coverage, phase 2). Each entity, static entity, client entity, structure (also those of REST and SOAP) is born with the anonymous record `<X> Record`, and each role with the exception `Not <Role>`; the delete counted them as consumers and refused a freshly created element. Now the generated type only counts when someone outside the target uses it (the refusal then names who uses it: tests/jobs-negative/delete-entity-list-type-in-use.json and delete-role-exception-in-use.json). The usages shows the anonymous record with derived true and real 0. Verify with no new messages.
